summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $37.7M from $45.0M.
The net loss narrowed to $39.6M, or −$2.58 per share, from $51.9M. Operating cash flow was −$37.0M and free cash flow −$37.0M, versus −$37.2M.
sources: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We will require substantial additional capital to finance our operations, and a failure to obtain this necessary capital when needed…
Our recurring losses from operations have raised substantial doubt regarding our ability to continue as a going concern
We may be unsuccessful in raising the capital necessary to address our going concern issues, or if we are successful, it may be on terms…
We have a history of operating losses that are expected to continue for the foreseeable future…
We have never generated revenue from product sales and may never become profitable
We have a limited operating history and we expect a number of factors to cause our operating results to fluctuate on a quarterly and annual basis…
strategy: Continue advancing ELI-002 7P in an ongoing randomized Phase 2 trial in PDAC
Expand ELI-002 7P clinical development for the treatment of other KRAS driven cancers
Advance development of our internal pipeline, including ELI-007 and ELI-008, for additional oncology targets
Realize the full value of the AMP technology through collaborations
